base_text: You are coughing repeatedly in a waiting room. The person across from you notices.

variants.warm: They walk over and offer you an unopened bottle of water from their bag.
variants.cold: They shift their chair further away and look down at their magazine quickly.
variants.adversarial: They loudly tell you that you should not be out in public spreading germs.
variants.neutral: They turn the page of their book and continue reading without looking up.

base_text: You trip on the sidewalk and scrape your knee. A pedestrian is walking toward you.

variants.warm: They ask if you need assistance and offer a clean bandage from their pocket.
variants.cold: They step over your outstretched leg and continue walking down the busy street.
variants.adversarial: They point at your knee and tell you to watch your step next time.
variants.neutral: They pause for a moment to let you stand up, then keep walking.

base_text: You are sneezing from severe seasonal allergies at the park. Someone is sitting on the bench.

variants.warm: They pull a clean tissue from their pocket and offer it to you.
variants.cold: They gather their belongings and move to a different bench across the park.
variants.adversarial: They state that your sneezing is ruining the quiet atmosphere of the area.
variants.neutral: They check their watch and stand up to continue their afternoon walk.

base_text: You are feeling dizzy and lean against a wall for support. A coworker walks past.

variants.warm: They ask if you need to sit down and offer to get a chair.
variants.cold: They walk to their desk without looking back to see if you are okay.
variants.adversarial: They claim you are faking the symptoms just to get out of doing work.
variants.neutral: They walk into the breakroom and pour themselves a cup of hot coffee.

base_text: You are carrying a bowl of hot soup to a sick relative. You drop a spoon.

variants.warm: They quickly pick up the spoon and offer to wash it for you.
variants.cold: They step around the dropped utensil and walk out the front door silently.
variants.adversarial: They kick the spoon away and loudly say you are making a huge mess.
variants.neutral: They walk around you to grab a glass of water from the kitchen sink.
